However, it is expected the economy will rebound from the depression, and inflation will occur. Copper price went between US$ 6,000‐6,500/t in September and October because speculating funds flowed into the market and negative factors were ignored. During the last quarter of 2009, the average LME copper cash price and three‐month price was US$6,648/t and US$6,675/t, respectively, up by 13.5% and 13.8% Q‐o‐Q while up 70.3% and 70.5% Y‐o‐Y. ##### **Highlights of Chinese copper market** Chinese domestic market copper price mainly flowed LME trend in October. During mid‐Nov and mid‐Dec, the price was about 55,000 yuan/t. The same with LME market, domestic copper price appeared the lowest and highest on the first day and the end day of the year, 24,530 yuan/t and 59,900 yuan/t. The average price of SHFE cash month copper and three month copper in Q4 was 52,946 yuan/t and 53,125 yuan/t respectively, up by 14.1% and 15.3% Q‐o‐Q, while up by 66.6 ％ and 77.6 ％ Y‐o‐Y. ##### **Chinese Copper Prices** ##### **Copper price climbs up in Q4** Chinese domestic market copper price mainly flowed LME trend in October. During mid‐Nov and mid‐Dec, the price was about 55,000 yuan/t. The same with LME market, domestic copper price appeared the lowest and highest on the first day and the end day of the year, 24,530 yuan/t and 59,900 yuan/t. Generally speaking, Chinese copper market performed well during 2009 with state reserve, large import and consumption supporting price. The average price of SHFE cash month copper and three month copper in Q4 was 52,946 yuan/t and 53,125 yuan/t respectively, up by 14.1% and 15.3% Q‐o‐Q, while up by 66.6 ％ and 77.6 ％ Y‐o‐Y. For the whole year of 2009, the average domestic copper cash price and three‐month price was 41,893 yuan/t and 41,389 yuan/t, down by 23.6% and23.2% y‐o‐y. 4 **Char1 3M Copper Price on SHFE and LME** 3M Prices on SHFE and LME, SHFE:yuan/t, LME: US$/t

##### **LME stocks continue to rise, SHFE stocks maintain high** LME copper stocks continued to gain since July 2009, but the growth rate slowed down gradually. By the end of 2009, the LME stock was 502kt, incresing 95.3% than July. The rising stock expressed a not very optimistic fundamentals. At the same time, Chinese SHFE copper stock increased to 100kt in Setember an maintained the level in Q4. Though domestic copper output create record high in Q4, the end use is not seen any improve. Invisible stock is also increase for the spot market supply is not loose. ##### **Global copper output and demand both rise** Global Copper production and demand both increased by a little margin in the fourth quarter of 2009. The output increased 2.7% Q‐o‐Q to 4.64mln tonnes and consumption increased 2.6% Q‐o‐Q to 4.33mln tonnes. The surplus status was almost the same with that in the third quarter. The total copper output in 2009 dropped 1.9% y‐o‐y to 18.08mln tonnes, and the total consumption fell 6.6% to 17.11mln tonnes with 970kt of surplus all year. Decline of the copper output was mainly caused by price fall in 2008 which led to suspend of many mine projects and cutback of production. Tight supply of copper concentrate made TC/RCs down sharply affecting the output. Developed cou

ntries like the USA, Japan and Germany decreased in consumption due to financial crisis. It is forecasted the global copper output and consumption will rebound in 2010. Growth rate of consumption will exceed that of output. Then copper surplus will be narrowed down to around 500kt. 7 **Table 2 Global Refined Copper Market Balance in 2007‐2010 Unit: kt** ||2007|Q1|Q2|2008

##### **Spot TC/RCs continue to move low** Before Christmas the Japanese copper smelters reached agreement on copper concentrate supply with Freeport McMoRan at US$46.5 per tonne/4.65 cents per pound. The TC/RCs decreased by 38% compared with that in 2009. Source from CSPT said China smelters accepted the TC/RCs offer of Freeport McMoRan. However, the world top mining company BHP has not reached an agreement with smelters yet. The latest offer from BHP was US$43 per tonne/4.3 cents per pound. At the spot market, TC/RCs were below US$20 per tonne/2.0 cents per pound with the lowest US$10 per tonne/1.0 cents per pound. Antaike considers quick falling of TC/RC was mainly due to expansion of smelting capacity, especially in China; tight supply of copper scraps and limited output growth in major mining companies. Sulfuric acid price was at historical low level in 2009. Many smelters depending on imported concentrates had already operated below production cost. At such a low price of sulfuric acid price and fixed TC/RCs for 2010, it is even worse environment for smelters this year. 8 **Table 3 Global Copper Concentrate Market Balance in 2007‐2009 kt** ||2007|Q1|Q2|2008

Chinese domestic average price was 200‐210 yuan/t in October and November. It rebounded to 260 yuan/t in December. Comparatively, the price offered by copper smelters was evel lower. Chinese sulfur import dropped Q‐o‐Q which was helpful for improve of sulfuric acid market balance. It is forecasted the sulfuric acid price will slowly moved up in Q1 2010.

##### **Mining expansion projects** 

Chinese mining expansion projects since this year are as following: 

**Aoergai Copper Mine** ’s 2,000t/d concentrating plant was commissioned on 27 Dec.2008. The plant is the first stage of 5,000t/d concentrating project. China Mining Resources Group Limited invested 200 mln yuan in Aoergai copper mine, which is located in Balinyouqi County, Inner Mongolia. After reaching full capacity, the project can produce 12,000t of copper concentrates (20% copper for 2,400t of copper metal). 

9 

**Xinjiang Ashele Copper Mine** ’s 1,500 t/d Brownfield project is expected to be operational in July this year on schedule. After reaching full capacity, the project can add production of 10,000t copper‐in‐ concentrate. Ashele copper mine was commissioned in the end of 2004 with daily mining capacity of 4,500t ores. 

**Jiangxi Copper** ’s Dexing Copper Mine has finished 7,500t/d expansion project by the end of June. Currently Dexing Copper Mine has mining capacity of 107.5kt/d. The 7,500t/d expansion project was invested in 360 mln yuan and took 10 months to be commissioned. The total project with 130kt/d capacity is expected to be finished completely in 2012 on schedule. Overall investment will reach 2.7 bln yuan. After the whole project being commissioned, its mining capacity will grow to 130kt/d from current 100kt. Outputs newly added will include 41kt copper‐in‐concentrate, 61kg gold and 25t silver. 

**Wushan Copper Mine** ’s 5,000 t/d project will reach full capacity in May. Jiangxi Copper’s copper‐in‐concentrate output is estimated to increase by 8,000 tonnes this year. 

**Chengmenshan Copper Mine** ’s stage 2 was kicked off in December, 2009. The stage 2 with investment of 500mln yuan will be constructed for 2 years, and it can process 7000t/d of ores and produce 14.8kt/y of copper. 

**Inner Mongolia Mining Co., Ltd** ’ s **Wunugetu Copper & Molybdenum Mine project** went into trial production recently. It was a key project in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.The project, in Hulun Buir City, was invested by Inner Mongolia Mining Company of China National Gold Group Corporation. The total investment is 2.8bln yuan. Now the proven reserves was 1.268mlnt of copper (average grade 0.46%), 258kt of molybdenum (average grade 0.055%) and the associated metals includes 34kt of zinc, 16t of silver and 7.991mlnt of alunite. The copper reserve ranks the 4th place in China. Construction of the project divided into three stages, and the stage 1 has been invested 2.84bln yuan. When the project is finished, it will process 30kt of ores per day and produce147kt of copper‐in‐concentrate and 7kt of molybdenum fine. 

Heilongjiang **Duobaoshan Copper‐Molybdenum Mine** launched workshop construction in end‐May. Duobaoshan Mine is invested by Heilongjiang Duobaoshan Copper Co., Ltd. (Duobaoshan Copper) with a total

investment of 3.0 bln yuan and planned to be finished by two stages. The first stage is going to be commissioned in 2011. After that it will be capable of processing 25kt ores per day, and producing 117,648 t copper concentrates (25% Cu) and 1,401 t molybdenum concentrates (45% Mo) per year. When the second stage being commissioned, 50kt ores can be processed per day, and outputs of copper concentrates (25% Cu) and molybdenum concentrates (45%) will reach 233,316t and 3,014 t respectively. **Duobaoshan Copper Mine** is located in north of Nenjiang County, Heihe City, Heilongjiang Province. The resources identified are 9.47% Cu for 1.78 mln t of copper metal, 0.016% Mo for 57.4kt of molybdenum, 0.144g/t Au for 60.29t gold and 2.059g/t Ag for 777.08t of silver. 10 **Duobaoshan Copper** is established in January 2006 with registered capital of 600 mln yuan. Its holding shareholder is Zijin Mining Group that owns 51% stock. Other shareholders are Heiongjiang Heilong Mining Co., Ltd. (37%owned), Heilongjiang Dilian Investment Co., Ltd (9% owned) and Harbin Baifu Investment Co., Ltd. (3%). ##### **Import of raw materials** In terms of the metal content, import of all copper raw materials post a sharp fall in 2009: net import of scraps decreased by 443kt, semis down 55kt and blister down 68kt. The added copper smeliting capacity in 2009 was 220ktpy, and the added copper refining capacity was 610ktpy. Chinese copper smelting and refining capacity reached 3.28ktpy and 5.57ktpy by the end of 2009. The main copper smelting/refining projects in 2009 are as follows: **Jiangxi Copper Co., Ltd. (Jiangxi Copper)** : Guixi Smelter’s Kaldo furnace went into trial production on May 11 this year. Restricted by tight supply of copper scrap, Kaldo furnace was unable to be operational since being commissioned in December 2008. It was invested in 130 mln

yuan, with many good properties such as high adaptability for raw material, short processing procedure, and high efficiency. At present, Guixi Smelter’s slag from tilting furnace and reflecting furnace are all processed by Kaldo furnace that is capable of producing 5t copper anode. **Yunnan Copper Co., Ltd.’** s (Yunnan Copper): 200ktpy refining project adopting ISA technology, which was kicked off in Oct. 2007, had been finished by the end of 2008. However, affected by the tight supply of raw material, the project has not ever been commissioned up to now. 100kt/y smelting project of **Chuxiong Dianzhong Nonferrous Metals Co., Ltd of Yunnan Copper** adopting ISA technology, which was commissioned on September 26, the project would increase smelting capacity by 70kt/y. 100kt/y smelting project of **Sichuan Liangshan Mining Co., Ltd of Yunnan Copper** is hopeful to be finished in Oct., and be commissioned in the end of this year. The construction of the project was kicked off in Jun. 2008 and major workshop was built completely in late‐May this year. **Fubang Copper Industry Co., Ltd.** ’s (Fubang Copper) 100kt/y smelting project has completed the construction work, and entered the equipment debugging stage. It is expected to install oxygen, acid and smelting systems in September, and come into production in October. Fubang Copper was built in May 2007 based on Linxi Jinding Copper Industry Co., Ltd., which was bought by Guangdong Qiaoxing Group. The smelting project is located in Jinding industrial zone in Linxi County Chifeng City, Inner Mongolia, and began the construction in March 2008, adopting oxygen side‐blowing smelting technology. An electrolysis project is also planned, but without any details. **Huludao Nonferrous Metals Group Co., Ltd** ’s 100kt/y smelting upgrading project is estimated to be put into operation in the end of this year or early next year. **Baiyin Nonferrous Metals (Group) Co., Ltd.** ’s 100kt/y refining project is delayed to be 15 ##### commissioned in H2, 2009. **Table 9 Smelting/refining capacity of Chinese key copper producers kt** ||Current|capacity|Newly‐ad|ded capacity in| |---|---|---|---|---| |||||2009

##### **Other projects ongoing:** 

At present, the smelting and refining capacity will be 240ktpy and 690ktpy respectively in 2010. By the end of 2010, Chinese copper smelting capacity will reach 3.52 mln tpy, and refining capacity will reach 6.26 mln tpy. There will be a new round commission peak period in 2011, including Daye’s reform project, Shandong Xiangguang Copper’s 2nd stage project and Zinjin Copper Industry’s new project. All these projects will be commissioned in 2011. It is estimated that the added smelting/refining capacity will exceed 700ktpy and 1mln tpy in 2011. 

—— On 11 March, a ceremony for the foundation of **Zijin Copper Industry Co. Ltd. (Zijin copper)** and a 200kt copper smelting project being put into operation were held at Jiaoyang village Shanghang County, Fujian Province. Zijin copper with registered capital of 1.0 bln yuan is owned by Zijin Mining Group Co., Ltd. (Zijin Mining) and its biggest shareholder Minxixinghang State‐owned Assets Investment Co., Ltd. (Minxixinghang) The two companies invested 500 mln yuan and owned 50% stake, respectively. Zijin Mining takes charge of the construction of the 200kt/y copper refining projects. The estimated investment is 2.6 bln yuan, capital asserts investment of which is 2.1 bln yuan and cash flow is 500 mln yuan. The construction scale of the project is 200ktpy refined copper and other by‐products of 5tpy gold, 113tpy silver and 700ktpy sulfide acid. According to Chen Jinghe said, the chairman of Zijin Mining, “200kt/y copper refining projects must be commissioned in two years. “ The project’s main work was kicked off in April this year and is expected to be operational in H1 2011.

##### **Refined production in Q4** 

Chinese copper production recovered in the fourth quarter increasing dramatically by 9.6% to 1.169mlnt compared with the third quarter. Output of copper‐in‐conc. was 277kt, up by 7.9% from the previous quarter; and output amounted to 940kt, a reduction of 3.6% y‐o‐y. Output of copper blister was 671kt in Q4, slightly down by 3.1% from the previous quarter, because parts of smelters are in yearly check. 

Output of copper concentrate in 2009 was 953kt in 2009, down by 0.9% from the previous year; output of copper blister increased by 9.4% to 2.627mlnt and output of refined copper was 4.123mlnt, up by 10.3%.
